messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: Pager fired for service=inference-embeddings region=eu-west1 — 5xx rate spike. alert_id=ALERT-2026-111 https://redwood.pagerduty/alerts/ALERT-2026-111

oncall-maria: Acked. I'm oncall — starting triage now. Pinging infra + eng-runtime.

jamal: Observing spike coincident with an edge proxy rollout at ~11:00 UTC. Errors are mostly `502` and `504` gateway timeouts. Quick Prometheus query:```\nsum(rate(http_requests_total{service="embeddings",status=~"5..",region="eu-west1"}[1m])) by (status)\n```

kevin: I pushed a proxy config change in `edge-proxy:v2.14.0` at 11:00 (rolling). Change adjusted upstream timeout from 30s -> 10s. Rollout command I used: `kubectl -n edge set image deploy/edge-proxy edge-proxy=ghcr.io/redwood/edge-proxy:v2.14.0`

liz: If the shorter timeout is causing upstreams to get cut off, we can flip traffic for embeddings to the stable backend. I'll prepare a rollback route.

liz: Running: `trafficctl set-route embeddings --backend embeddings-stable --weight 100` (will drain canary).

sre-runbook: Runbook snippet — triage steps:
1) Confirm affected region + error patterns.
2) If change is recent, revert or increase upstream timeout.
3) Route traffic to stable variant to reduce customer impact.
4) Collect request IDs and sample traces for RCA.

Commands:
```\n# increase upstream timeout
kubectl -n edge set env deploy/edge-proxy UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=30
# or rollback build
kubectl -n edge rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy
```

oncall-maria: Doing a quick `kubectl rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy -n edge` now. Will watch metrics.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by oncall-maria. Escalation rules: next escalation to kevin at +5min if not resolved.

jamal: After routing embeddings to `embeddings-stable` and undoing the rollout, 5xx rate dropped from ~2.1% -> ~0.3% within ~90s. Latency also normalized.

kevin: I'll own the follow-up patch to make the shorter timeout opt-in per-service. Opening ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/ENGINF-5421 — adding rollback/patch notes.

liz: Customer impact summary: subset of EU customers experienced embedding failures between 11:00–11:08 UTC; ~120 failed requests/min peak, retry rate increased client-side. Recommend support message draft.

oncall-maria: I'll notify Support and add this to the incident report. Creating a private notes doc and capturing sample request IDs/traces.

sre-runbook: Handoff: kevin will monitor for 2 hours, then create a postmortem with timeline & remediation (timeout defaults + safer rollout). Tagging `#postmortem` and `#eng-runtime`.

jamal: Quick note — saved a small trace sample (trace IDs in private notes) and the proxy logs showing `upstream connection timed out` entries.

oncall-maria: Closing pager for now, will update PD once follow-ups are tracked. :white_check_mark:
